discover.title: Discover
discover.intro: Three areas: paths, question list, and suggested answer. The book icon on the selected row runs Discover for a proposition.
discover.pickPath: Select a path from the list on the left.
discover.loadQuestionsError: Could not load questions for this path.
discover.ctaTooltip: Discover a suggested answer to this question
discover.proposedAnswerPickQuestion: Select a question in the middle panel to see its suggested answer.
discover.proposedAnswerEmpty: No suggested answer here yet. Use the Discover icon to generate one.
discover.propositionLoadError: Could not load the suggested answer: endpoint not found or wrong API path (404). Check the backend.
discover.propositionUnexpectedShape: Response received but the proposition text field was not recognized.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Summary of your evaluations: exploration, level reached, and progress.
dashboard.mindMapIntro: Colours: grey (0 evaluations), blue (fewer than 3), amber (3 to 6), green (more than 6). The number in parentheses is the total evaluations for each path.
dashboard.gaugesIntro: A half-circle gauge per theme, filled according to the weighted average score (out of 100) across its paths. The label and evaluation count show overall exploration.
dashboard.radarIntro: Averages per criterion (relevance, precision, clarity) and overall score, for each path with at least one evaluation.
dashboard.radarLegendHint: Click a path in the legend to open the review.
dashboard.progressionIntro: Points follow chronological order of each evaluation creation date (fallback to id order if a date is missing). Raw score (dashed), 5-evaluation moving average (solid curve), and cumulative average per theme.
dashboard.progressionEmpty: No evaluation recorded yet. Come back after a few sessions!
dashboard.loadError: Could not load dashboard data. Check that the API is reachable.
dashboard.progressionXTitle: Time (creation date of each evaluation, chronological order)

adminThemes.title: Themes & paths
adminThemes.hint: Create, edit, and delete themes and their learning paths (sub-themes). API calls expect REST routes on the backend — see comments in ApiService.
adminThemes.noThemesApi: No themes returned by the API. Create a theme or check the backend.
adminThemes.aiLead: Pick a theme from the selected discipline: the server uses its title and description as stored to generate paths and questions (the persisted theme stays the same).
adminThemes.bulkAiPanelTitle: Paths and questions for an existing theme
adminThemes.bulkAiPanelDesc: Themes for the current discipline (`GET /themes/all_themes`). Sends `themeId` / `id_theme` to `POST /themes/generate-parcours-and-questions` (extra label/description fields in the body are optional; the backend reads the theme from the database).
adminThemes.bulkAiNoDescription: No description for this theme — only the label will be sent.

adminThemes.snackBulkAiEmptyLabel: The selected theme has no usable label.
adminThemes.snackBulkAiSent: Path / question generation sent to the server.
